blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The defense of former President Rodrigo Duterte has asked the International Criminal Court (ICC) to slash by sixfold the prosecution’s massive trove of evidence, saying the more than 62,000 items are bloated with irrelevant, duplicate and defective material that the lawyers cannot realistically review before trial.
